reviews.title: Runs cooler than expected
reviews.comment: Super fast and incredibly smooth. The 9900X3D tears through gaming and multitasking without even trying. Load times are basically instant, and the extra cache really does make games feel snappier. Runs cooler than I expected, too. If you’re building on AM5 and want a processor that just feels effortless, this one’s a winner.
